description: This file contains the implementation of an SMTP client class used for sending emails via an SMTP server. It provides methods for connecting, authenticating, sending messages, and controlling SMTP transactions following RFC 821.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: A PHP class that implements SMTP protocol to send emails by communicating directly with SMTP servers, supporting various SMTP commands such as HELO, MAIL, RCPT, DATA, and authentication procedures.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified SMTP server on a given port with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication using LOGIN method with provided username and password.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Initiates a mail transaction from a specified sender email.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from the SMTP server response, parsing multi-line replies.
